CIN-00.title: 序幕：遲到的邀請
lines: 山路上的故障耽誤了行程。隔日凌晨三點，我才抵達。
A breakdown delayed my journey. I arrived at 03:00 the following morning.
邀請我的人，是五年前火災的倖存者——王杰倫。
My host was Wang Jielun, a survivor of the fire five years ago.
聚會的小屋，只剩下仍在冒煙的廢墟。
The cabin where we were to meet was a smoking ruin.
警方找到了四具焦屍，身分仍在複核；初步判定是意外。
The police found four burned bodies. Identification was pending; the initial finding was an accident.
火災後第四天，現場完成初步處置。我獲准回來調查。
On the fourth day after the fire, I was permitted to return after initial site stabilization.

CIN-A.title: 客房：灰燼裡的謊言
lines: 鄭筱柔的筆記，藏在燒毀的行李之中。
Zheng Xiaorou's notes were hidden in the burned luggage.
她曾報導王家無人生還，但小兒子其實活了下來。
She reported that no one in the Wang family survived. The younger son had lived.
那封威脅信，讓這次聚會有了另一種意味。
The threatening letter cast a different light on this gathering.
破錶停在十九點十五分。但停錶，還不是死亡時間的證明。
The broken watch stopped at 19:15. That alone did not establish a time of death.
EVIDENCE-01
三只杯子與空瓶，留下了尚待交叉比對的痕跡。
Three glasses and an empty bottle left traces that needed corroboration.

CIN-B.title: 暗房：不在照片裡的人
lines: 被光線吞沒的影像，重新浮現。
An image lost in the light began to emerge.
十八點三十分的照片裡，謝宇恩仍在。
Xie Yuen was present in the photograph taken at 18:30.
二十點的最後合照，鏡頭前三人，加上攝影師，共四人。
At 20:00, the last photograph showed three people; with the photographer, four.
謝宇恩不在照片裡。他當時去了哪裡？
Xie Yuen was not in the photograph. Where had he gone?

CIN-C.title: 營火：善意與異常重量
lines: 謝宇恩帶來烤肉架，原本只是想讓朋友開心。
Xie Yuen brought the grill hoping to cheer up his friend.
日記裡的道歉，加上表層報告，讓我以為這是恐懼引起的失控。
The apologies in the diary and the surface report made me suspect a collapse brought on by fear.
預定食材只有五公斤，歷史紀錄卻留下六十五公斤。
The planned food weighed five kilograms. The historical record showed sixty-five.
固定底座保存了二十一點的歷史紀錄。控制器卻不在座上。
The fixed base retained the 21:00 record. Its detachable controller was missing.
烤架下的項鍊，與第一張照片裡的輪廓一致。
The pendant beneath the grill matched the outline in the first photograph.

CIN-D.title: 診療區：另一種飢餓
lines: 深層報告記錄了極度飢餓，以及曾食用親屬遺體的疑慮。
The deeper report recorded extreme hunger and suspected consumption of relatives' remains.
烤肉的氣味，可能喚醒的不是恐懼，而是食慾。
Perhaps the smell of the grill awakened appetite rather than fear.
拍攝紀錄、現場採樣與檢查摘要，讓線索有了相互支持的方向。
Recording logs, scene samples and examination summaries began to corroborate one another.
警方確認了四名死者：鄭筱柔、邱凱浩、謝宇恩、張凱涵。沒有王杰倫。
Police identified the four dead: Zheng Xiaorou, Qiu Kaihao, Xie Yuen and Zhang Kaihan. Wang Jielun was not among them.
他先離開。火災中倒下的鐵櫃，後來才擋住出口。
He left first. The cabinet fell during the fire and blocked the exit afterward.
門框先被使用，細灰後來才覆上；這仍不能單獨辨認使用者。
The frame was used before ash settled on it. The traces alone could not identify who used it.
主門雖然反鎖，地下室卻有對外維修出口。他有機會活著離開。
The main door was bolted, but a basement maintenance exit led outside. He could have escaped alive.

CIN-END.title: 終幕：深淵的凝視
lines: END-01
四名死者之中，沒有王杰倫。那條出口，讓另一種可能浮現。
Wang Jielun was not among the four dead. The exit left another possibility.
END-02
我朝出口奔去，身後的黑暗卻留在原地。
I ran for the exit. The darkness behind me remained.
END-03
樹洞裡，有一雙眼睛一直看著我。
A pair of eyes watched me from the hollow tree.
END-04
［吞嚥聲］［感測器歸零音］
[Swallowing sound] [Sensor reset tone]
END-05
冷光照亮了那張熟悉的臉。
The cold light revealed a familiar face.
END-06
［風聲逐漸消失］
[The wind fades away]
